aboutContent.intro:
HuanYou Travel is a comprehensive travel enterprise dedicated to premium travel services. We strive to provide every client with a unique, comfortable, and safe travel experience.

Over more than a decade of growth, we have built an extensive service network covering destinations at home and abroad, with a team of over 200 professional guides and more than one million travelers served. Whether you prefer classic group tours or fully customized private journeys, we have the perfect solution for you.

We steadfastly uphold the philosophy of "Customer First, Quality Foremost" — rigorously selecting partners and meticulously designing every route to ensure each traveler enjoys a journey worth far more than the price paid.
aboutContent.story:
The idea for HuanYou Travel was born from a simple trip. In 2011, our founding team was traveling in Zhangjiajie and noticed how many visitors struggled with overwhelming travel information, making it hard to find a truly high-quality experience. And so, a vision took shape: create a travel service platform devoted to quality.

From a handful of classic routes at the outset to hundreds of curated journeys across the country and beyond today, we have always held fast to the principle of "Quality First, Service Above All." Over 15 years, we have served more than two million travelers and earned countless rave reviews and lasting trust.

Looking ahead, HuanYou Travel will continue to innovate in the travel industry, introducing new services so that every traveler enjoys a worry-free, safe, and joyful journey.

testimonials.name: Ms. Wang
testimonials.text: My first time visiting Chongqing and Zhangjiajie — I booked the 7-day tour and our guide Xiao Li was incredibly professional with detailed commentary. The itinerary was well-paced with no rushing, and we had an amazing time! Definitely choosing HuanYou again next time!

testimonials.name: Mr. Zhang
testimonials.text: The Jiuzhaigou trip was absolutely breathtaking! Visiting in autumn feels like a fairyland — the lake colors are mesmerizing. The agency arranged everything thoughtfully and the accommodation was great. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Ms. Li
testimonials.text: Took my child on the 10-day Beijing and Yunnan tour — the pace was relaxed and never tiring, and my kid had a blast. The Great Wall, Forbidden City, and the ancient towns of Dali and Lijiang were the highlights. Our guide patiently answered every question. A truly trustworthy agency!
